facts.status_note: Register and Firelookout.org list say the tower was removed; the only physical evidence described is footings photographed in October 2008

resolved_conflicts.explanation: Register, Forest Lookouts and the NHLR history give 1928. A 1949 column says a man carried lumber for a 25-foot tower twenty-eight years earlier, which points to about 1921. The story gives 1928 as the date most sources give and reports the column.
NHLR history says Cheat Ranger District; Forest Lookouts says Chert Ranger District. Chert appears to be a misspelling of Cheat; the story uses Cheat.
The 1949 column spells the mountain Musark; the register and other sources use Mozark.

notes_for_editor: Built date conflicts with the 1949 column (about 1921 implied); register, Forest Lookouts and NHLR agree on 1928. Ranger district spelled Cheat (NHLR) vs Chert (Forest Lookouts). No source describes access or the site today beyond the October 2008 footings photo. Brief's agency matches the register.
